scope: Every ancestor directory of the tracked source tree, including root. Descriptions explain current functional ownership; archived structures remain inactive evidence.

One modular Solver AI repository joining the working practice application, independently bounded services, development tooling, planned tasks and preserved research evidence.

directories.apps: User-facing applications with framework-owned entry points and feature modules.
directories.apps/web: Next.js and TypeScript practice interface, account authority, browser feature modules and web-owned build tooling.
directories.apps/web/app: Next.js App Router entry points, root layout and global styles that compose the feature modules.
directories.apps/web/app/account: Account route that passes a constrained continuation path to the sign-in and registration interface.
directories.apps/web/app/api: Framework HTTP route adapters served by the web process.
directories.apps/web/app/api/auth: Better Auth HTTP route namespace for session, JWT and public-key operations.
directories.apps/web/app/api/auth/[...all]: Node-runtime catch-all Better Auth adapter that initializes supported migrations before handling authentication requests.
directories.apps/web/app/problems: Problem route namespace for individual practice workspaces.
directories.apps/web/app/problems/[slug]: Dynamic problem route that resolves the public slug and mounts the practice workspace.
directories.apps/web/app/submissions: Route entry point for the authenticated learner submission-history interface.
directories.apps/web/components: Shared navigation shell and SVG icon components reused by the application features.
directories.apps/web/features: Product-owned browser and server modules grouped by accounts, authored hints, practice and submissions.
directories.apps/web/features/accounts: Account form, browser session client and server-side Better Auth authority with persistent local state.
directories.apps/web/features/hints: Authenticated authored-hint requests and UI with bounded contracts, provenance validation, cancellation and safe errors.
directories.apps/web/features/practice: Problem catalog, public response validation, practice workspace and locally persisted Monaco or textarea editing.
directories.apps/web/features/submissions: Explicit run and submit actions, bounded API requests, capability checks and private saved-result history.
directories.apps/web/scripts: Web-owned official auth migration and locally bundled Monaco asset preparation commands.
directories.apps/web/tests: Real Better Auth integration checks using isolated temporary databases and keys.
directories.docs: Active product and engineering documentation indexed by functional responsibility.
directories.docs/architecture: Current and proposed service boundaries, repository organization and recorded architecture decisions.
directories.docs/architecture/adr: Dated decisions documenting the practice foundation and authenticated isolated judging boundaries.
directories.docs/engineering: Contributor workflow, scoped implementation tasks and coding-agent practices.
directories.docs/engineering/backlog: Canonical ordered task catalogue, generated issue cards and actual publication receipts.
directories.docs/engineering/backlog/issues: One generated Markdown card per stable backlog task with prerequisites, ownership paths and acceptance criteria.
directories.docs/governance: Maintainer decisions, original-code and content rights, and build-versus-reuse policies.
directories.docs/onboarding: Contributor orientation and reproducible installation, startup, validation and deployment instructions.
directories.docs/product: Product vision, requirements, roadmap and the retained detailed idea and solver proposals.
directories.docs/research: Dated audits, upstream study references, competitive positioning and model-evaluation proposals.
directories.docs/security: Judge threat model, untrusted-execution boundaries and production release controls.
directories.docs/status: Named-revision implementation evidence, current limitations and historical validation distinctions.
directories.scripts: Repository command implementations for local development, explicit GitHub tooling and verification.
directories.scripts/development: Native web, API and worker lifecycle orchestration and private local worker-token selection.
directories.scripts/github: Offline backlog generation, explicit safe issue publication and inert pull-request evidence checking.
directories.scripts/verification: Packaging exclusion guards and deterministic inventory and preservation checks.
directories.services: Independently bounded application services and the trusted judge control plane.
directories.services/api: Python FastAPI application, frozen dependencies, container definition and service-owned tests.
directories.services/api/solver_api: Stable API entry point composing feature modules and shared HTTP behavior.
directories.services/api/solver_api/features: Server feature boundaries for catalog, authored hints, fixed identity verification and owned submissions.
directories.services/api/solver_api/features/catalog: Original public problem content and validated catalog response models.
directories.services/api/solver_api/features/hints: Authenticated authored-hint contract and a bounded future-provider interface without real model inference.
directories.services/api/solver_api/features/identit: Fixed-issuer and fixed-JWKS bearer authentication for account-owned API access.
directories.services/api/solver_api/features/submiss: Durable owned SQLite jobs, source history, quotas, idempotency and worker lease completion.
directories.services/api/solver_api/http: Shared bounded request bodies, correlated safe error handling and HTTP support.
directories.services/api/tests: API-owned regression suites grouped by their server feature responsibility.
directories.services/api/tests/catalog: Catalog and shared request or error contract tests.
directories.services/api/tests/hints: Authored-hint authentication, provenance, provider-boundary and failure-contract tests.
directories.services/api/tests/identity: JWT, JWKS, issuer and authentication-boundary tests.
directories.services/api/tests/submissions: Ownership, durable queue, quotas, idempotency, lease and completion regression tests.
directories.services/judge: Trusted host judge controller, sandbox image definition and independently gated execution tests.
directories.services/judge/solver_judge: Judge control, grading and restricted-program modules with deliberately shared bounded process transport.
directories.services/judge/solver_judge/control: Trusted Docker and gVisor runner, worker lifecycle and read-only readiness diagnostics.
directories.services/judge/solver_judge/grading: Original problem grading cases and trusted expected-answer computations kept outside learner programs.
directories.services/judge/solver_judge/sandbox: Restricted learner-program supervisor copied into the isolated sandbox image.
directories.services/judge/tests: Judge tests grouped by trusted control, grading and actual isolation boundaries.
directories.services/judge/tests/control: Runner protocol, worker leasing and container lifecycle cleanup regression tests.
directories.services/judge/tests/grading: Deterministic original grading-case and expected-answer checks.
directories.services/judge/tests/sandbox: Bounded process transport checks and explicitly enabled live gVisor isolation tests.
directories.tests: Cross-service browser regressions and repository-tooling safety tests.

directories.tests/e2e/hints: Guest and authenticated hint provenance, failure, timeout, cancellation and context-change browser checks.

directories.tests/e2e/submissions: Account lifecycle, explicit isolated judging and cross-user private-history browser checks.
directories.tests/tooling: Repository automation tests isolated from application services and remote side effects.
